Hi Alex / Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and the asks we said we'd follow up on re: authentication and key management so your infra/security team can triage: 

1) Recommended auth patterns — we outlined two options during the call:
   - API keys scoped to project + per-environment keys (recommended for quick POC).
   - OAuth2 / JWT service accounts for production workloads with fine-grained scopes (recommended for regulated flows and long-term deployments).

2) Key rotation — you asked about rotation frequency and automation. Redwood supports:
   - Manual rotation via Console (single-click regenerate) + immediate revocation.
   - Rotation API (we provide endpoints to create/rotate/revoke keys, and can integrate with your KMS to store encrypted keys).

3) Service accounts & audit — we can issue short-lived JWTs for server-to-server flows and support per-service-account audit logging (exportable to your SIEM).

4) SDK examples — Neha will send a quick Node + curl snippet showing how to set Authorization headers and call embeddings/reranker endpoints.

5) Routing & structured output — we mentioned using route policies to send latency-sensitive requests to lower-latency model variants and using function-calling/structured-output to keep outputs deterministic for downstream processing.

Next steps proposed:
- We’ll attach an architecture diagram and a short SOC2 Q&A template for your security team.
- Neha: send SDK/auth snippets and rotation pattern examples.
- Alex / Samantha: confirm which option you prefer for the POC (API keys or service accounts) and share any internal constraints (KMS provider, rotation cadence).

Attachments: fintechco-integration-arch-diagram.png, SOC2-questions.xlsx

Thanks —

Hi Alex / team —

Quick examples below to illustrate both flows. Please treat the keys/tokens below as examples only.

1) API key (curl):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer API_KEY_FINTECHCO_STAGING" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"input":"Summarize transactions"}'

2) Node SDK example (service account / JWT):

// install @redwoodai/sdk
const { RedwoodClient } = require('@redwoodai/sdk');
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  auth: {
    type: 'jwt',
    serviceAccountKey: process.env.REDSERVICE_KEY_JSON
  },
  region: 'us-west-2'
});

const resp = await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-chat-1', input: 'Hello' });

Notes on rotation & audit: 
- Rotation API: POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/rotate returns new key material and revokes old key automatically.
- KMS integration: we can configure Redwood to encrypt key blobs with your GCP KMS customer-managed key (CMK) — keys in our DB are then stored ciphertext-only.
- Short-lived tokens: recommend issuing short-lived JWTs (1 hour) to servers that exchange service-account credentials for an access token; refresh via the token endpoint. Short-lived tokens reduce blast radius.

Embeddings / reranker notes: use the same auth header as other endpoints. For reranking we recommend a dedicated service account with limited scope (only reranker/embed endpoints) to restrict blast radius.

I attached a minimal rotation workflow diagram to the Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/fintechco/integration-specs

Happy to jump on a quick call with your security engineer to walk through the rotation flows.

—Neha
